source: Derived from EEA 2023 - EU average generation intensity
notes: Zero at the vehicle by definition; the emissions are at the power station. Compare on WTW, never on TTW. Payload cancels, so GLEC's basis carries over. EXCLUDES upstream fuel supply for generation, so it understates against the diesel WTW row. Grid intensity varies more than fivefold between countries — never apply one average across a multi-country route.
